title: Sealed Bagging of Contaminated Debris on Water Damage Mitigation Jobs
content:
Water Damage Mitigation sanitation standard. Contaminated debris is bagged and sealed before it leaves the property, setting a sanitation multiplier on the per-load rate of the job's tear-out debris haul-off line:
- 1.25 on a Category 3 job carrying pad removal or flood cut lines;
- 1.1 on a Category 2 job carrying pad removal or flood cut lines;
- in any other case no sanitation multiplier applies.

The water category is the IICRC category recorded on the job.

## Combinations
| Water category | Pad removal or flood cut lines on the job | Sanitation multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Category 3 | yes | 1.25 |
| Category 2 | yes | 1.1 |
| Category 3 or 2 | no (for example carpet removal only) | none |
| Category 1 | any | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical)
A Category 3 sewer backup job with flood cut lines has its per-load rate multiplied by 1.25; a Category 2 job whose only tear-out is pad removal has it multiplied by 1.1.
